title: 6 Myths About Eggs Busted
tags: which is better brown or white eggs
are brown eggs healthier than white
description:
Eggs are one of the most common foods on the planet, but they are also surrounded by myths and misinformation. From whether supermarket eggs can hatch into chicks to the belief that brown eggs are healthier than white ones, we crack open the science behind these misconceptions.

In this episode of Pale Blue Thoughts, we explore:

Why grocery store eggs never hatch into chicks.

The truth about fertilized vs unfertilized eggs and the role of roosters.

What candling reveals about egg development.

Should eggs be stored in the refrigerator or at room temperature?

Do egg yolks really increase cholesterol and heart disease risk?

Are brown eggs more nutritious than white eggs?

Do duck eggs cure piles (hemorrhoids) as Ayurveda claims?

The big myth about hormones in broiler chickens.

👉 If you’ve searched for can store-bought eggs hatch, fertilized vs unfertilized eggs, egg cholesterol myth, brown eggs vs white eggs nutrition, duck eggs piles cure, hormones in broiler chickens — this video gives you the clear, rational perspective.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations!
